name: Armorskin Robes of Air

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
This +1 resilient explorer's clothing is woven with thread spun by an elemental, and it sparkles with radiant color. A strong breeze wafts from the thread, blowing attacks off course. You gain resistance 5 to electricity damage.

Activate—Elemental Sheath 1 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

---
Effect The elemental threads cover your skin, further protecting you but limiting mobility. For 10 minutes, you gain resistance 5 to slashing and piercing damage but take a –5-foot status penalty to all Speeds. While activated, you gain a +1 status bonus to your AC against physical ranged attacks.
